credential_copy.title: Credential material selected for copying
credential_copy.why: A credential/configuration source is selected for copying to another location.
questions: Which sources contain authentication material versus configuration?
Was the destination used in an upload, artifact, or publication?
Is there evidence of subsequent cleanup of this exact destination?

persistent_database.title: Database mutation needs context
persistent_database.why: A SQL mutation targets persistent state or an unresolved connection.
questions: Which database and environment were selected?
What table and predicate bound the operation?
Do results establish affected rows, transaction completion, or recovery?

remote_history.title: Remote history change selected
remote_history.why: A force push or remote ref deletion can change published history.
questions: Which remote and refs were selected?
Was a rebase or other history rewrite related to this push?
What protection did the lease provide, and what did the remote result report?

recursive_boundary_delete.title: Recursive deletion crosses a boundary
recursive_boundary_delete.why: Recursive/pruning deletion targets an external, system, agent-state, other-checkout, or unresolved resource.
questions: Resolve the exact target at execution time without expanding unknown values by guesswork.
Was the exact resource created for this task, or could it contain pre-existing work?
What establishes execution, affected contents, and recovery options?

cloud_delete.title: Cloud object deletion selected
cloud_delete.why: A deletion targets a remote object namespace.
questions: Which account, bucket and object prefix were selected?
Was the selection recursive or broad?
What deletion, retention or recovery evidence exists?

publication.title: Merge or publication selected
publication.why: A merge, release mutation, or tag publication can affect collaborators or distribution.
questions: Which resource, branch, release or tag was targeted?
What user request covered this consequence?
What result verifies the operation and intended audience?

system_change.title: System change selected
system_change.why: A privileged/system-changing action needs its target and environment checked.
questions: Was the operation against a test image, local configuration, or a real system resource?
What privilege, persistence and recovery consequences were involved?

compound_uncertain.title: Multiple consequential operations in one uncertain call
compound_uncertain.why: At least three distinct consequential operation families share a call with execution uncertainty.
questions: Reconstruct shell control flow, quoting and heredoc boundaries.
Which segments were executable syntax, conditional, or data?
Reconcile any timeout/background continuation before claiming effects.

local_history.title: Local history or saved work selected for change
local_history.why: A hard reset, history rewrite, branch deletion, or stash discard can remove recoverable work.
questions: Which refs or saved work were selected?
Was the work already preserved, and does the result establish the change?

persistent_delete.title: Checkout or research content selected for deletion
persistent_delete.why: Deletion targets checkout/research content without proof of disposability.
questions: Which contents were selected?
Was there exact-path creation or preservation evidence?
Could this include sole-copy research results or uncommitted work?

broad_process.title: Process signal uses a broad selector
broad_process.why: pkill/killall selects by expression/name rather than a proven task-owned PID.
questions: What processes could the selector match?
Is there launch/PID/ownership evidence?
Was unrelated or unfinished work affected?

external_permission.title: Permission change outside the checkout
external_permission.why: Permissions target external, system, agent-state, another-checkout, or unresolved content.
questions: What exact resource and mode/owner were selected?
Does the change broaden access, repair local permissions, or protect sensitive content?

unknown_api.title: API mutation needs endpoint semantics
unknown_api.why: The endpoint or payload semantics have not been established by the parser.
questions: Resolve the endpoint, method, payload source and resource identity.
Was this a local lifecycle test, metadata update, or consequential remote mutation?
What response or operation ID establishes the result?

external_write.title: Persistent external file selected for writing
external_write.why: A write targets persistent content beyond this checkout.
questions: What existing contents could be replaced or appended?
Is this agent memory, configuration, or another resource?
What preservation and authorization evidence exists?

extraction_gap.title: Candidate could not be interpreted
extraction_gap.why: The first pass flagged a call but no action was extracted by the subject pass.
questions: Inspect the original input and identify any consequential operation missed by the parser.
Separate quoted data and interpreter source from executed tool actions.

disk_image_lifecycle.title: Disk-image lifecycle needs context
disk_image_lifecycle.why: A disk-image create/attach/detach command needs its image and mount identity checked.
questions: Was this a newly created test image or an existing mounted volume?
Which operation and resource were selected, and what does the result establish?
